user.title: House Structure
user.description: Set the house once. Then add its parts from the integration's page: each room's size, its outside walls and roofs, the windows in them, the walls between rooms, and the heating registers. Each part is a device in its room's area.

data_description.rotation: Degrees the house is turned clockwise from true north. Its four faces then look this far past north, east, south and west.
data_description.shade_below: Treat the south-east to south-west sun as blocked by trees and neighbours below this elevation. A wall or roof can set its own.
data_description.unit: Sizes are typed in this unit and kept in metres, so changing it later keeps them.

reconfigure.title: House Structure
reconfigure.description: Change the house's rotation, shading or unit. Every part picks up the change.

data_description.rotation: Degrees the house is turned clockwise from true north.
data_description.shade_below: Treat the south-east to south-west sun as blocked below this elevation.
data_description.unit: Sizes are typed in this unit and kept in metres, so changing it keeps them.

abort.single_instance_allowed: House Structure is already set up.

user.title: Room
user.description: A room's own size. One per area; leave a size empty if you do not know it. Sizes in {unit}.

data_description.name: Leave empty for a name from the room.
data_description.volume: Leave empty for floor area times ceiling height. Give it for a sloped ceiling.
data_description.below_ground: Tick for a basement room: its walls trade heat with the soil.

user.title: Window
user.description: A window in a wall or roof; it takes its room and the way it faces from there. Glass size in {unit}.

data.name: Name
data.host: Wall or roof it is in
data.transmittance: Share of light let in as heat
data.blind_closed: Share let in with the blind closed

data_description.name: Leave empty for a name from the room.
data_description.transmittance: About 0.7 for double glazing, 0.5 for low-e.
data_description.blind: A cover entity; its position (0 to 100) says how open it is.
data_description.blind_closed: How much of the sun still gets in with the blind shut.
